item.title: ‘We Are Running Out of Time’: 2025 Keeps Hot Streak Alive for Global Temperatures
item.description: For the first time global temperatures over a three-year period have exceeded the critical threshold of 1.5°C above preindustrial levels.

item.title: A safer approach to gene editing
item.description: The first challenge is that CRISPR cells have a hard time penetrating the cells removed from patients, also called primary T cells.

item.title: The Medieval Catholic Inquisition

item.title: Overpopulation is a major factor in global mortality
item.description: In many countries, overpopulation, poverty and lack of food increase hunting of wildlife for ”bush-meat” and other products.
